items.title: Dua al-Faraj
items.occasion: Recited daily, any time — for the wellbeing and hastened return of Imam al-Mahdi (AS)
items.reference: Narrated via Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, from the righteous (AS); Mafatih al-Jinan
items.description: One of the shortest and most widely recited daily duas in Ja'fari practice — a brief plea for Imam al-Mahdi's (AS) protection and guidance, said to be recited at any time, in any state.
items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ اللَّهُمَّ كُنْ لِوَلِيِّكَ الْحُجَّةِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ صَلَواتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آبَائِهِ فِي هٰذِهِ السَّاعَةِ وَفِي كُلِّ سَاعَةٍ وَلِيّاً وَحَافِظاً وَقَائِداً وَنَاصِراً وَدَلِيلاً وَعَيْناً حَتَّى تُسْكِنَهُ أَرْضَكَ طَوْعاً وَتُمَتِّعَهُ فِيهَا طَوِيلاً بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
items.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. O Allah, be for Your representative, the Hujjah, son of al-Hasan — Your blessings be upon him and upon his forefathers — in this hour and in every hour, a guardian, a protector, a leader, a helper, a guide, and a watcher, until You make him live on Your earth in willing obedience and let him enjoy it for a long time, by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
items.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے جو نہایت رحم والا، بہت مہربان ہے۔ اے اللہ! اپنے ولی، حجت بن الحسن — تیری رحمتیں اس پر اور اس کے آباء پر ہوں — کے لیے اس گھڑی میں اور ہر گھڑی میں، ولی، حافظ، قائد، ناصر، دلیل اور نگہبان ہو جا، یہاں تک کہ تُو اسے اپنی زمین پر خوشی سے آباد کر دے اور اسے وہاں طویل عرصہ تک بہرہ مند رکھے، اپنی رحمت کے ساتھ، اے سب سے زیادہ رحم کرنے والے۔

items.title: Dua al-Ahd
items.occasion: Recited every morning, ideally for 40 consecutive days — a renewed pledge of allegiance to Imam al-Mahdi (AS)
items.reference: Sayyid ibn Tawus, Misbah al-Za'ir; Bihar al-Anwar (al-Majlisi); duas.org
items.description: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) is narrated to have said: whoever recites this dua for 40 mornings will be counted among the helpers of Imam al-Mahdi (AS) — and if they die before his reappearance, Allah will raise them from their grave to join his cause. A renewal of one's pledge (ahd) to the awaited Imam, said every morning. After the main dua, strike your right thigh three times, saying the closing line each time.
items.arabic:
اَللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النُّورِ العَظِيمِ وَرَبَّ الْكُرْسِيِّ الرَّفِيعِ وَرَبَّ الْبَحْرِ الْمَسْجُورِ وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنْجِيلِ وَالزَّبُورِ وَرَبَّ الظِّلِّ وَالْحَرُورِ وَمُنْزِلَ الْقُرْآنِ العَظِيمِ وَرَبَّ الْمَلَائِكَةِ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ وَالْأَنْبِيَاءِ وَالْمُرْسَلِينَ، اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْكَرِيمِ وَبِنُورِ وَجْهِكَ الْمُنِيرِ وَمُلْكِكَ الْقَدِيمِ، يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِي أَشْرَقَتْ بِهِ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْأَرَضُونَ وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِي يَصْلُحُ بِهِ الْأَوَّلُونَ وَالْآخِرُونَ، يَا حَيّاً قَبْلَ كُلِّ حَيٍّ وَيَا حَيّاً بَعْدَ كُلِّ حَيٍّ وَيَا حَيّاً حِينَ لَا حَيَّ، يَا مُحْيِيَ الْمَوْتَى وَمُمِيتَ الْأَحْيَاءِ، يَا حَيُّ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.

اَللَّهُمَّ بَلِّغْ مَوْلَانَا الْإِمَامَ الْهَادِيَ المَهْدِيَّ القَائِمَ بِأَمْرِكَ، صَلَوَاتُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آبَائِهِ الطَّاهِرِينَ، عَنْ جَمِيعِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ فِي مَشَارِقِ الْأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبِهَا، سَهْلِهَا وَجَبَلِهَا، وَبَرِّهَا وَبَحْرِهَا، وَعَنِّي وَعَنْ وَالِدَيَّ، مِنَ الصَّلَوَاتِ زِنَةَ عَرْشِ اللَّهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ وَمَا أَحْصَاهُ عِلْمُهُ وَأَحَاطَ بِهِ كِتَابُهُ.

اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُجَدِّدُ لَهُ فِي صَبِيحَةِ يَوْمِي هٰذَا وَمَا عِشْتُ مِنْ أَيَّامِي عَهْداً وَعَقْداً وَبَيْعَةً لَهُ فِي عُنُقِي، لَا أَحُولُ عَنْهُ وَلَا أَزُولُ أَبَداً. اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنْ أَنْصَارِهِ وَأَعْوَانِهِ وَالذَّابِّينَ عَنْهُ، وَالمُسَارِعِينَ إِلَيْهِ فِي قَضَاءِ حَوَائِجِهِ، وَالمُمْتَثِلِينَ لِأَوَامِرِهِ، وَالمُحَامِينَ عَنْهُ، وَالسَّابِقِينَ إِلَى إِرَادَتِهِ، وَالمُسْتَشْهَدِينَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ.

اَللَّهُمَّ إِنْ حَالَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ الْمَوْتُ الَّذِي جَعَلْتَهُ عَلَى عِبَادِكَ حَتْماً مَقْضِيّاً، فَأَخْرِجْنِي مِنْ قَبْرِي مُؤْتَزِراً كَفَنِي، شَاهِراً سَيْفِي، مُجَرِّداً قَنَاتِي، مُلَبِّياً دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِي فِي الْحَاضِرِ وَالْبَادِي.

اَللَّهُمَّ أَرِنِي الطَّلْعَةَ الرَّشِيدَةَ وَالْغُرَّةَ الْحَمِيدَةَ، وَاكْحُلْ نَاظِرِي بِنَظْرَةٍ مِنِّي إِلَيْهِ، وَعَجِّلْ فَرَجَهُ، وَسَهِّلْ مَخْرَجَهُ، وَأَوْسِعْ مَنْهَجَهُ، وَاسْلُكْ بِي مُحَجَّتَهُ، وَأَنْفِذْ أَمْرَهُ، وَاشْدُدْ أَزْرَهُ، وَاعْمُرِ اللَّهُمَّ بِهِ بِلَادَكَ، وَأَحْيِ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ، فَإِنَّكَ قُلْتَ وَقَوْلُكَ الْحَقُّ: «ظَهَرَ الْفَسَادُ فِي الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِي النَّاسِ»، فَأَظْهِرِ اللَّهُمَّ لَنَا وَلِيَّكَ وَابْنَ بِنْتِ نَبِيِّكَ الْمُسَمَّى بِاسْمِ رَسُولِكَ، صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ، حَتَّى لَا يَظْفَرَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنَ الْبَاطِلِ إِلَّا مَزَّقَهُ، وَيُحِقَّ الْحَقَّ وَيُحَقِّقَهُ.

وَاجْعَلْهُ اللَّهُمَّ مَفْزَعاً لِمَظْلُومِ عِبَادِكَ، وَنَاصِراً لِمَنْ لَا يَجِدُ لَهُ نَاصِراً غَيْرَكَ، وَمُجَدِّداً لِمَا عُطِّلَ مِنْ أَحْكَامِ كِتَابِكَ، وَمُشَيِّداً لِمَا وَرَدَ مِنْ أَعْلَامِ دِينِكَ وَسُنَنِ نَبِيِّكَ، صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ، وَاجْعَلْهُ اللَّهُمَّ مِمَّنْ حَصَّنْتَهُ مِنْ بَأْسِ الْمُعْتَدِينَ.

اَللَّهُمَّ وَسُرَّ نَبِيَّكَ مُحَمَّداً، صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ، بِرُؤْيَتِهِ وَمَنْ تَبِعَهُ عَلَى دَعْوَتِهِ، وَارْحَمِ اسْتِكَانَتَنَا بَعْدَهُ. اَللَّهُمَّ اكْشِفْ هٰذِهِ الْغُمَّةَ عَنْ هٰذِهِ الْأُمَّةِ بِحُضُورِهِ، وَعَجِّلْ لَنَا ظُهُورَهُ، «إِنَّهُمْ يَرَوْنَهُ بَعِيداً وَنَرَاهُ قَرِيباً»، بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.

(ثم اضرب على فخذك الأيمن ثلاثاً وقل في كل مرة:)
الْعَجَلَ الْعَجَلَ يَا مَوْلَايَ يَا صَاحِبَ الزَّمَانِ
items.translation:
O Allah, Lord of the Great Light, Lord of the Elevated Throne, Lord of the swollen ocean, Revealer of the Torah, the Gospel and the Psalms, Lord of shade and heat, Revealer of the Great Qur'an, Lord of the Archangels, the Prophets and the Messengers — O Allah, I beseech You in Your Noble Name, in the light of Your luminous Face, and Your eternal kingdom — O Ever-Living, O Self-Subsisting! I beseech You in the name with which the heavens and the earth lit up, and in the name with which the past and coming generations become upright — O He who has always been alive before all living things, O He who shall be alive after the extinction of all living things, O He who has always been alive when nothing else was alive, O Reviver of the dead and Causer of death to the living, O Ever-Living, there is no god but You.

O Allah, convey to our master, the Imam, the Guide, al-Mahdi, who shall rise by Your command — Allah's blessings be upon him and his immaculate forefathers — on behalf of all believing men and women in the east and west of the earth, its plains and mountains, its lands and seas, and on behalf of me and my parents, blessings as weighty as Allah's Throne, as much as the ink of His Words, and as many as what His knowledge has counted and His Book encompassed.

O Allah, I renew for him, on the morning of this day of mine and for as long as I live, a covenant, a pledge, and an allegiance to which I commit myself in my own neck; I shall never turn away from it nor abandon it. O Allah, make me one of his supporters, his aides, those who defend him, those who hasten to fulfil his needs, those who comply with his orders, those who protect him, those who race to carry out his will, and those who are martyred before him.

O Allah, if death — which You have made an inevitable decree upon Your servants — comes between him and me, then raise me from my grave, shrouded in my burial cloth, brandishing my sword, holding my lance, responding to the caller's summons in every land, near or far.

O Allah, show me his guided countenance and his praiseworthy face, and delight my eyes with a glimpse of him; hasten his relief, ease his path, widen his way, and set me upon his course; carry out his command and strengthen his resolve. O Allah, populate Your lands through him and give life to Your servants through him — for You have said, and Your word is true: "Corruption has appeared on land and sea because of what people's hands have wrought." So show us, O Allah, Your representative, the son of Your Prophet's daughter, named after Your Messenger — blessings be upon him and his Household — so that he leaves no falsehood unshredded and establishes and confirms the truth.

O Allah, make him a refuge for Your wronged servants, a helper for those who find no helper but You, a reviver of what has been suspended of Your Book's laws, and an upholder of what remains of Your religion's signs and Your Prophet's ways — blessings be upon him and his Household — and place him among those You protect from the might of the aggressors.

O Allah, delight Your Prophet Muhammad — peace be upon him and his Household — with a sight of him and of those who follow his call, and have mercy on our helplessness after him. O Allah, lift this distress from this nation through his presence, and hasten his reappearance for us: "They think it is far off, but We see it near." By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

(Then strike your right thigh three times, saying each time:)
Hasten, hasten, O my Master, O Master of the Age!
items.urdu:
اے اللہ! عظیم نور کے رب، بلند عرش کے رب، جوش زن سمندر کے رب، تورات، انجیل اور زبور کے نازل کرنے والے، سائے اور گرمی کے رب، عظیم قرآن کے نازل کرنے والے، مقرب فرشتوں، نبیوں اور رسولوں کے رب — اے اللہ! میں تجھ سے تیرے کریم نام کے وسیلے سے، تیرے چہرے کے روشن نور کے وسیلے سے، اور تیری قدیم بادشاہت کے وسیلے سے سوال کرتا ہوں — اے زندہ! اے قائم رہنے والے! میں تجھ سے اس نام کے وسیلے سے سوال کرتا ہوں جس سے آسمان اور زمینیں روشن ہوئیں، اور اس نام کے وسیلے سے جس سے اگلے اور پچھلے لوگ درست ہوتے ہیں — اے وہ جو ہر زندہ سے پہلے زندہ تھا، اور اے وہ جو ہر زندہ کے بعد زندہ رہے گا، اور اے وہ جو زندہ تھا جب کوئی زندہ نہ تھا، اے مرنے والوں کو زندہ کرنے والے اور زندوں کو موت دینے والے، اے زندہ! تیرے سوا کوئی معبود نہیں۔

اے اللہ! ہمارے آقا، امام، ہادی، مہدی، جو تیرے حکم سے قائم ہوں گے — اللہ کی رحمتیں ان پر اور ان کے پاک آباء پر ہوں — تک تمام مومن مردوں اور عورتوں کی طرف سے، مشرق و مغرب کی زمین میں، اس کے سہل و پہاڑ میں، اس کی خشکی و سمندر میں، اور میری اور میرے والدین کی طرف سے، اتنی رحمتیں پہنچا جو اللہ کے عرش کے وزن کے برابر ہوں، اس کے کلمات کی سیاہی جتنی ہوں، اور جتنی اس کے علم نے شمار کی اور اس کی کتاب نے احاطہ کیا۔

اے اللہ! میں آج کی صبح، اور جتنے دن میں زندہ رہوں، ان کے لیے ایک عہد، ایک عقد، اور ایک بیعت اپنی گردن میں تازہ کرتا ہوں، جس سے میں کبھی نہ پھروں گا اور نہ الگ ہوں گا۔ اے اللہ! مجھے ان کے مددگاروں، معاونوں، ان کا دفاع کرنے والوں، ان کی حاجتیں پوری کرنے میں جلدی کرنے والوں، ان کے احکام کی تابعداری کرنے والوں، ان کی حمایت کرنے والوں، ان کی مرضی کی طرف سبقت کرنے والوں، اور ان کے سامنے شہید ہونے والوں میں سے بنا دے۔

اے اللہ! اگر موت — جو تُو نے اپنے بندوں پر لازمی مقرر کر دی ہے — میرے اور ان کے درمیان حائل ہو جائے، تو مجھے میری قبر سے اٹھا، اپنے کفن کو کمر پر باندھے ہوئے، اپنی تلوار لہراتے ہوئے، اپنا نیزہ اٹھائے ہوئے، ہر جگہ پکارنے والے کی آواز پر لبیک کہتے ہوئے۔

اے اللہ! مجھے ان کا رشید چہرہ اور محمود پیشانی دکھا، اور میری آنکھوں کو ان کی ایک نظر سے ٹھنڈا کر؛ ان کی فرج میں جلدی فرما، ان کا راستہ آسان کر، ان کی راہ وسیع کر، اور مجھے ان کے راستے پر چلا؛ ان کے حکم کو نافذ فرما اور ان کی قوت کو مضبوط کر۔ اے اللہ! ان کے ذریعے اپنے شہروں کو آباد فرما اور اپنے بندوں کو زندہ کر — کیونکہ تُو نے فرمایا، اور تیرا فرمان سچ ہے: "خشکی اور سمندر میں فساد پھیل گیا اس کی وجہ سے جو لوگوں کے ہاتھوں نے کیا۔" پس اے اللہ! ہمیں اپنا ولی دکھا، اپنے نبی کی بیٹی کا بیٹا، جو تیرے رسول کے نام پر رکھا گیا — ان پر اور ان کی آل پر درود ہو — تاکہ وہ کسی باطل کو غالب نہ آنے دیں مگر اسے پارہ پارہ کر دیں، اور حق کو ثابت اور قائم کریں۔

اے اللہ! انہیں اپنے مظلوم بندوں کی پناہ گاہ بنا، اور ان کا مددگار جن کا تیرے سوا کوئی مددگار نہیں، اور تیری کتاب کے معطل شدہ احکام کو زندہ کرنے والا، اور تیرے دین کی نشانیوں اور تیرے نبی کی سنتوں کو قائم رکھنے والا بنا — ان پر اور ان کی آل پر درود ہو — اور اے اللہ! انہیں ان لوگوں میں شامل فرما جنہیں تُو نے ظالموں کے وار سے محفوظ رکھا ہے۔

اے اللہ! اپنے نبی محمد ﷺ کو ان کے دیدار سے، اور ان لوگوں کے دیدار سے جو ان کی دعوت پر چلے، خوش فرما، اور ان کے بعد ہماری بےچارگی پر رحم فرما۔ اے اللہ! اس اُمّت سے یہ غم ان کی موجودگی کے ذریعے دور فرما، اور ہمارے لیے ان کا ظہور جلد فرما: "وہ اسے دور سمجھتے ہیں اور ہم اسے قریب دیکھتے ہیں۔" تیری رحمت کے ساتھ، اے سب سے زیادہ رحم کرنے والے۔

(پھر اپنی دائیں ران پر تین بار ہاتھ مار کر ہر بار کہیں:)
جلدی فرما، جلدی فرما، اے میرے آقا، اے صاحبِ زمان!

items.title: Amal-e-Ashura
items.occasion: 10th of Muharram — martyrdom of Imam al-Husayn (AS) at Karbala
items.reference: Al-Kafi (al-Kulayni), cited in Ali Asghar Ridwani, 'The Uprising of Ashura and Responses to Doubts' (al-islam.org); Grand Ayatollah Sistani, Islamic Laws, Ruling 1715 (sistani.org)
items.description:
The Day of Ashura is a day of mourning in Ja'fari practice, not celebration.

FASTING: Hadith recorded by al-Kulayni in al-Kafi — from Imam al-Baqir (AS), Imam al-Sadiq (AS), and Imam al-Rida (AS) — describe fasting on Ashura as the practice adopted by Ibn Ziyad's partisans, who treated the day of Imam al-Husayn's (AS) martyrdom as a day of celebration. Following this, Grand Ayatollah Sistani rules it is makruh (discouraged) to fast on Ashura with the intention of a religious fast; instead, it is recommended to refrain from food and drink until Asr, without the intention of fasting, as an act of mourning.

ZIYARAT: The central recitation of the day is Ziyarat Ashura — see 'Ziyarat Ashura' under Ziyarat in this Fiqh Library — including its salutations and disavowals, each traditionally repeated 100 times, and the dua that follows it.

MOURNING: Attending majalis (mourning gatherings), weeping for Imam al-Husayn (AS) and his companions, and — where possible — visiting his shrine in Karbala, have been the practice of the Shi'ah since the earliest generations.
items.urdu:
یومِ عاشورہ اہلِ تشیع کے ہاں سوگ کا دن ہے، خوشی منانے کا نہیں۔

روزہ: کلینی نے الکافی میں امام باقر علیہ السلام، امام صادق علیہ السلام اور امام رضا علیہ السلام سے روایت نقل کی ہے کہ عاشورہ کے دن روزہ رکھنا ابن زیاد کے پیروکاروں کا طریقہ تھا، جنہوں نے امام حسین علیہ السلام کی شہادت کے دن کو جشن کا دن بنا لیا۔ اسی بنیاد پر آیت اللہ العظمیٰ سیستانی کا فتویٰ ہے کہ عاشورہ کے دن روزے کی نیت سے روزہ رکھنا مکروہ ہے؛ بلکہ روزے کی نیت کے بغیر عصر تک کھانے پینے سے رکنا سوگ کے اظہار کے طور پر مستحب ہے۔

زیارت: اس دن کی مرکزی زیارت، زیارتِ عاشورہ ہے — دیکھیں 'زیارتِ عاشورہ' زیارت کے حصے میں، اسی فقہ لائبریری میں — جس میں سلام اور لعن کے حصے روایتاً سو سو بار پڑھے جاتے ہیں، نیز اس کے بعد کی دعا۔

سوگ: مجالسِ عزا میں شرکت، امام حسین علیہ السلام اور ان کے ساتھیوں پر گریہ، اور ممکن ہو تو کربلا میں ان کے روضے کی زیارت — یہ سب ابتدائی نسلوں سے شیعہ عمل کا حصہ رہے ہیں۔

items.title: Amal of the Day of Arafah
items.occasion: 9th of Dhu al-Hijjah — the day of standing at Arafat during Hajj
items.reference: Grand Ayatollah Sistani, Islamic Laws, ruling on recommended fasts (sistani.org); imam-us.org, 'The Day of Arafah'
items.description:
The Day of Arafah is described by Imam al-Sadiq (AS) as 'the day of supplication and asking Allah for one's needs.'

FASTING: Fasting on the Day of Arafah is mustahab (recommended) for those not performing Hajj. Grand Ayatollah Sistani rules that if fasting weakens a person to the point that they cannot recite the day's duas, then fasting that day is disapproved instead — the dua matters more than the fast.

GHUSL: Ghusl at midday is recommended, and is said to take the place of wudu for the prayers that follow.

DUA: Several duas are especially recommended for this day, most famously the long Dua Arafah attributed to Imam al-Husayn (AS) — some sources attribute it instead to Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS). Its full text is a separate, longer addition still being sourced for this app. Shorter duas recommended alongside it include one the Prophet (SAW) taught Imam Ali (AS), and a dua for the day narrated from Imam al-Sadiq (AS).

Note: In Ja'fari practice, Ashura's mourning and Arafah's supplication are treated very differently — see 'Amal-e-Ashura' for the Day of Ashura's own, distinct practices.
items.urdu:
امام صادق علیہ السلام کے قول کے مطابق، یومِ عرفہ 'دعا اور اللہ سے اپنی ضرورتیں طلب کرنے کا دن' ہے۔

روزہ: جو حج پر نہ ہو اس کے لیے یومِ عرفہ کا روزہ مستحب ہے۔ آیت اللہ العظمیٰ سیستانی کا فتویٰ ہے کہ اگر روزہ اس حد تک کمزور کر دے کہ انسان اس دن کی دعائیں نہ پڑھ سکے، تو ایسی صورت میں روزہ نہ رکھنا بہتر ہے — دعا روزے سے زیادہ اہم ہے۔

غسل: دوپہر کے وقت غسل مستحب ہے، اور کہا جاتا ہے کہ یہ بعد کی نمازوں کے لیے وضو کی جگہ لے لیتا ہے۔

دعا: اس دن کے لیے کئی دعائیں خاص طور پر مستحب ہیں، سب سے مشہور امام حسین علیہ السلام سے منسوب طویل دعائے عرفہ ہے — بعض روایات میں اسے امام زین العابدین علیہ السلام سے بھی منسوب کیا گیا ہے۔ اس کا مکمل متن ایک الگ، طویل اضافہ ہے جس پر ابھی کام جاری ہے۔ اس کے ساتھ چھوٹی دعائیں بھی مستحب ہیں، جن میں ایک نبی اکرم ﷺ کی امام علی علیہ السلام کو سکھائی گئی دعا، اور امام صادق علیہ السلام سے مروی اس دن کی دعا شامل ہیں۔

نوٹ: شیعہ عمل میں عاشورہ کا سوگ اور عرفہ کی دعا بہت مختلف انداز میں برتے جاتے ہیں — یومِ عاشورہ کے اپنے اعمال کے لیے 'اعمالِ عاشورہ' ملاحظہ کریں۔

items.title: Amal of Nisf Sha'ban (15th of Sha'ban)
items.occasion: 15th of Sha'ban — birth of Imam al-Mahdi (AS)
items.reference: en.wikishia.net, 'Mid-Sha'ban' (citing Iqbal al-A'mal by Ibn Tawus and Bihar al-Anwar by al-Majlisi); imam-us.org, 'Significance of the Night of 15th Sha'ban'; almerja.com, recommended acts for 15 Sha'ban
items.description:
The night of the 15th of Sha'ban is the birthday of the Twelfth Imam, Muhammad al-Mahdi (AS), and one of the most blessed nights of the year.

GHUSL: Performing ghusl on this night is recommended.

PRAYER: Various prayers are narrated for this night in Iqbal al-A'mal and Mafatih al-Jinan — commonly two rak'ahs (in one narration: Surah al-Fatiha and al-Kafirun in the first, al-Fatiha and al-Ikhlas in the second, followed by the tasbih of Sayyida Fatimah al-Zahra (AS)), and elsewhere a longer prayer of ten rak'ahs with al-Ikhlas repeated in each. Different narrations describe different structures — Mafatih al-Jinan and Iqbal al-A'mal record more than one, so this is not a single fixed form.

STAYING AWAKE: It is narrated that whoever stays awake on this night, his heart will not die on the day when hearts die (i.e. the Day of Judgment).

DUA AND ZIYARAT: Reciting Dua Kumayl (recited by Imam Ali (AS), taught to him by Khidr) is among the night's most emphasized practices — its full text is not yet available in this app and is being sourced separately. A ziyarat of Imam al-Husayn (AS), such as Ziyarat Ashura in this Fiqh Library, is also recommended tonight.

IMAM AL-MAHDI (AS): As this is his birthday, supplicating for his wellbeing and hastened reappearance, and — where possible — visiting his birthplace/the Sardab in Samarra, are especially recommended tonight.

پندرہ شعبان کی رات بارہویں امام، امام محمد المہدی علیہ السلام کی پیدائش کی رات ہے، اور سال کی بابرکت ترین راتوں میں سے ایک ہے۔

غسل: اس رات غسل کرنا مستحب ہے۔

نماز: اس رات کے لیے اقبال الاعمال اور مفاتیح الجنان میں مختلف نمازیں مروی ہیں — عام طور پر دو رکعتیں (ایک روایت میں: پہلی رکعت میں سورۃ الفاتحہ اور سورۃ الکافرون، دوسری میں سورۃ الفاتحہ اور سورۃ الاخلاص، پھر حضرت فاطمہ الزہرا علیہا السلام کی تسبیح)، اور دوسری جگہ دس رکعتوں کی ایک لمبی نماز جس میں ہر رکعت میں سورۃ الاخلاص دہرائی جاتی ہے۔ مختلف روایات مختلف ترتیب بیان کرتی ہیں — چونکہ مفاتیح الجنان اور اقبال الاعمال ایک سے زیادہ نمازیں درج کرتے ہیں، اس لیے کوئی ایک مقررہ صورت نہیں۔

بیداری: روایت ہے کہ جو اس رات بیدار رہے، اس کا دل اس دن نہیں مرے گا جب سب دل مر جائیں گے (یعنی قیامت کے دن)۔

دعا اور زیارت: دعائے کمیل کی تلاوت (جو امام علی علیہ السلام نے پڑھی، جو انہیں حضرت خضر علیہ السلام نے سکھائی) اس رات کے سب سے زیادہ تاکید کیے گئے اعمال میں سے ہے — اس کا مکمل متن ابھی اس ایپ میں شامل نہیں، اس پر الگ سے کام جاری ہے۔ امام حسین علیہ السلام کی کوئی زیارت، جیسے اسی فقہ لائبریری میں موجود زیارتِ عاشورہ، بھی آج رات مستحب ہے۔

امام مہدی علیہ السلام: چونکہ یہ ان کی سالگرہ ہے، ان کی سلامتی اور ظہور کی جلدی کے لیے دعا کرنا، اور ممکن ہو تو سامرا میں ان کی جائے پیدائش/سرداب کی زیارت، اس رات خاص طور پر مستحب ہے۔

items.translation: True are the words of Allah, the All-great. There is no god save Him, the Ever-living, the Eternal, The Lord of Majesty and Honor, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful, the Forbearing, the All-generous. There is nothing like Him, and He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing, the All-seeing, the All-aware. Allah bears witness that there is no god but He, and (so do) the angels and those possessed of knowledge, maintaining His creation with justice. There is no god but He, the Mighty, the Wise. His noble Messengers have conveyed the mission and I am of those who bear witness to that. O Allah, to You belongs praise, to You belongs glory, to You belongs might, to You belongs pride, to You belongs supreme power, to You belong bounties, to You belongs greatness, to You belongs mercy, to You belongs reverence, to You belongs sovereignty, to You belongs beauty, to You belongs benevolence, to You belongs glorification, to You belongs holiness, to You belongs the confession of Your being the One and Only God, to You belongs the confession of Your being the most Great Lord, to You belongs that which is seen, to You belongs that which is not seen, to You belongs that which is far above the high heavens, to You belongs that which is deep down under the abyss, to You belong the worlds below the heavens, to You belong the end and the beginning, and to You is all thanks, all praise, all gratitude, and all bliss as much as it pleases You. O Allah, (please do) send blessings to (Archangel) Gabriel, the trustee on Your revelations, the firm in conveying Your orders, the obeyed in Your heavens and the places where Your honoring lies, the bearer of Your Words, the supporter of Your Prophets, and the terminator of Your enemies. O Allah, (please do) send blessings to (Archangel) Michael, the angel of Your mercy, the one created for (showing) Your kindness, and the one seeking forgiveness and assisting the people of obedience to You. O Allah, (please do) send blessings to Seraph, the bearer of Your Throne, the one in charge of the Trumpet (that declares the Resurrection Day), the one waiting for Your order, and the one apprehensive and fearful of You. O Allah, (please do) send blessings to the pure angels who bear Your Throne, upon the scribes; the noble, the virtuous, and the immaculate, upon Your angels; the virtuous recorders (of the deeds), upon the angels of the gardens of Paradise, upon the keepers of Hellfire, and upon the Angel of Death and his assistants. O Lord of Majesty and Honor! O Allah, (please do) send blessings to our father Adam: the foremost of Your creation whom You honored by making Your angels prostrate themselves before him, and whom You allowed to dwell in Your Paradise. O Allah, (please do) send blessings to our mother Eve: the purified from filth, the cleaned from dirt, the favorite from among the humankind, and the allowed to visit the places of sanctity. O Allah, (please do) send blessings to Abel, Shayth, Idris, Noah, Hud, Salih, Abraham, Ishmael, Isaac, Jacob, Joseph, the Tribes, Lot, Shu`ayb, Job, Moses, Aaron, Joshua, Micah, al-Khidr, Dhu’l-Qarnayn (the two-horned), Jonah, Elias, Elisa, Dhu’l-Kifl, Saul, David, Solomon, Zachariah, Shayah, John, Turakh, Matthias, Jeremiah, Habakkuk, Daniel, Ezra, Jesus, Simon, Georges, the Apostles, the Followers, Khalid, Hanzalah, and Luqman. O Allah, (please do) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, have mercy upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, and send benedictions upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, just as You have sent blessings, had mercy, and sent benedictions upon Abraham and the Household of Abraham. You are verily worthy of all praise, full of all glory. O Allah, (please do) send blessings to the Successors, the happy, the witnesses, and the leaders to the true guidance. O Allah, (please do) send blessings to the Substitutes (whom shall be given the favor of participating in Imam al-Mahdi’s campaigns, the loftiest personalities < those observing fasting with devotion, those who ardently serve You, those whom You have chosen, the ascetic servants, and the people of painstaking and hardworking deeds. (Please do) give Muhammad and his Household exclusively the best of Your blessings and the most abundant of Your favors. (Please do) convey to his soul and body my greetings and compliments and give him more favors, honor, and esteem so that You will make him attain the most elevated ranks of the honored ones from amongst the Prophets, the Messengers, and the virtuous, favorable ones. O Allah, (please) send blessings to those whose names I have mentioned or I have not from amongst Your angels, Prophets, Messengers, and obedient servants. Convey my invocations of blessings to them and to their souls and make them my brethren in You and make them help me pray You. O Allah, I seek Your intercession for me to You, I seek Your honor in the name of Your honor, I seek Your magnanimity in the name of Your magnanimity, and I seek Your mercy in the name of Your mercy and in the name of the people of the obedience to You. I thus beseech You, O Allah, in the name of all the things by whose names those people have besought You, including the honorable requests that are never rejected by You and all the responded and unfailing prayers that they have asked from You. O Allah! O All-beneficent! O All-merciful! O All-forbearing! O All-generous! O All-great! O All-majestic! O Bestower! O All-munificent! O Surety! O Dependable! O Rescuer! O Protector! O All-aware! O All-luminous! O Eradicator (of the wrongdoers)! O Shielding! O Grantor of victory! O Assuring! O All-big! O All-powerful! O All-seer! O most Ready to appreciate (servitude)! O All-benign! O Source of purity! O All-pure! O Omnipotent! O Evident! O Immanent! O Concealer! O All-encompassing! O All-prevailing! O All-guarding! O Invincible! O Nigh! O Loving! O All-praised! O full of all glory! O Originator! O Reproducer! O Witness! O All-liberal! O All-bountiful! O Source of all bounties! O Doer of favors! O Straitening! O Enlarger! O Guide! O Sender! O Director! O Leader (to the truth)! O Giver! O Forbidder! O Repealer! O Raiser! O Eternal! O Guardian! O Creator! O Endower! O Accepter of repentance! O Decider! O Donator! O Source of rest! O He Who has in possessions the clues of all things! O Source of profit! O All-kind! O All-sympathetic! O Securer! O Healer! O Curer! O Awarder! O Faithful! O Dominant! O Almighty! O All-potent! O Superb! O Giver of peace! O Grantor of security! O Only One! O Besought of all! O Light! O Manager (of all affairs)! O Single! O Lone! O Holy! O Giver of victory! O Source of entertainment! O Resurrector! O Inheritor (of all things)! O All-knowing! O Judge! O Originator! O Exalted! O Maker of visions! O Grantor of safety! O Amiable! O Subsistent! O Everlasting! O Knowing! O Wise! O All-magnanimous! O Maker! O Caring! O Source of pleasure! O Fair! O Distinguisher (between the right and the wrong)! O Master! O All-munificent! O Favorer! O All-hearer! O best Maker! O Observer! O Helper! O Extender (of mercy)! O Forgiver! O Eternal! O Alleviator! O Reliever! O He Who causes to die! O Grantor of life! O Grantor of benefits! O Provider of sustenance! O All-competent! O Creator of causes! O Aide! O Grantor of wealth! O Giver to hold! O Creator! O Onlooker! O One! O Present! O Mender! O Safeguarding! O Firm (in punishment)! O Aid! O Donor! O Straitening! O He Who has mounted to the most elevated point, He thus occupies the most exalted site! O He Who has approached so closely that He has become the nearest of all things and, at the same time, He has been so far that He is in the furthest point, and He has known the secret and even what is more hidden! O He to Whom all management is relegated and to Whom all measures are referred! O He for Whom the most difficult thing is easy and simple! O He Who has power to do whatever He wills! O He Who sends forth the wind! O He Who causes the dawn to break! O He Who revives the spirits! O Lord of magnanimity and lenience! O He Who has the power to restore that which has been missed! O He Who resurrects the dead bodies! O He Who draws together the dispersal! O He Who provides sustenance to whomever He wants without measure! O He Who has power to do whatever He wills however He wills! O Lord of Majesty and Honor! O Ever-living! O Self-subsistent! O He Who existed when there existed nothing else! O Ever-living! O Reviver of the dead! O Ever-living! There is no god save You the excellent Maker of the heavens and the earth. O my God and my Master, (please do) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, have mercy upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, and send benedictions upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad just as You have sent blessings and benedictions and had mercy upon Abraham and the household of Abraham. You are verily worthy of all praise and full of all glory. Have mercy upon my humiliation, neediness, poverty, loneliness, aloneness, humbleness before You, reliance upon You, and submission to You. I implore You with the imploring of the humble, the subservient, the fearful, the scared the afraid, the miserable, the modest, the insignificant, the hungry, the poor, the seeker of Your refuge, the seeker of Your protection, the confessing of his sins, the implorer for You to forgive his sin, and the humble to his Lord; I implore You with the imploration of one whom has been disappointed by those whom he trusts, rejected by his intimate ones, and whose catastrophe has been enormous. I implore You the imploration of one burning, sad, weak, mortified, depressed, wretched, and resorting to Your shelter. O Allah, I also beseech You in the name of Your being the King, whatever You will shall definitely take place, and You have power over all things. I beseech You in the name of the holiness of this sacred month, the Sacred House, the Sacred Town, the Rukn (i.e. the corner of the Holy Ka`bah), the Maqam (i.e. the standing-place of Prophet Abraham), the great rituals, and in the name of Your Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him and his Household. O He Who gave Shayth to Adam, and gave Ishmael and Isaac to Abraham! O He Who returned Joseph to Jacob! O He Who relieved Job from his harm after long hardships! O He Who returned Moses to his mother! O He Who increased al-Khadir knowledge! O He Who gave Solomon to David, gave Jonah to Zachariah, and gave Jesus to Mary! O He Who safeguarded the daughter of Shu`ayb! O He Who cared for the son of the mother of Moses! I beseech You to send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, forgive my all sins, save me from Your chastisement, and confer upon me with Your pleasure and security and with Your favoring, forgiveness, and gardens of Your Paradise. I ask You to redeem me from all circles of misfortune that are drawn around those who intend harm to me and me, unlock for me all doors, make easy for me all hardships, alleviate for me all difficult matters, mute all those who speak ill of me, defend me against all oppressors, suppress all my enemies and envious ones, protect me against all unjust ones, and rescue me from all impediments that lie between my needs and me, try to take me away from acts of obedience to You, and try to frustrate me from serving You. O He Who has bridled all mutinous jinn, overcome all tyrannical devils, mortified the necks of the oppressors, and deterred all the ruling authorities from harming the enfeebled ones! I beseech You in the name of Your power over all things and Your alleviating whatever You will however You will, to grant my requests as You will. O Allah, I am prostrating myself before You and I have full faith in You; so, (please) have mercy upon my humility, neediness, efforts, meekness, paucity, and my want to You, O my Lord. You should try to shed even a single drop of tear, for this is the signal of admission.

WHO WAS UMM DAWUD: Fatima, mother of Dawud, a great-grandson of Imam Hasan al-Mujtaba (AS) and a foster brother of Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) - she had served as his wet-nurse. When her son Dawud went missing (imprisoned, as it turned out), she visited the ailing Imam, who taught her this Amal. She performed it on the 15th of Rajab; the very next day, Dawud was released and returned home.

TIME: Fast on the 13th, 14th and 15th of Rajab (this Amal may also be performed in any other month, or on the Day of Arafah - if Arafah falls on a Friday, one who performs it is said to be forgiven before even finishing).

METHOD: After the obligatory Zuhr and Asr prayers on the 15th, face the Qiblah and recite:
- Surah al-Fatiha (1) x100
- Surah al-Ikhlas (112) x100
- Ayat al-Kursi (2:255-257) x10
- Surah al-An'am (6) once
- Surah Bani Isra'il/al-Isra (17) once
- Surah al-Kahf (18) once
- Surah Luqman (31) once
- Surah Ya-Sin (36) once
- Surah al-Saffat (37) once
- Surah Ha-Mim Sajdah/Fussilat (41) once
- Surah al-Shura (42) once
- Surah al-Dukhan (44) once
- Surah al-Fath (48) once
- Surah al-Waqi'ah (56) once
- Surah al-Mulk (67) once
- Surah al-Qalam (68) once
- Surah al-Inshiqaq (84) once
- Surahs al-Buruj through al-Nas (85-114) once each

Then, still facing the Qiblah, recite Dua Umm-e-Dawud (given below), followed by a closing dua while in sajdah.

This Amal is traditionally recited to have a specific, pressing need fulfilled - a due request, freedom for someone imprisoned, or relief from a hardship.
